$comment: Every asset format the system produces, in one place: print sheets in inches, screen canvases in pixels. A page never restates a size: {{formats:GROUP}} renders a group's table and {{canvas:ID}} fills a preview's style attribute (see src/styles/canvas.css). Each format names the page that shows it, so a format without a page fails the build. Sizes and limits are the platforms' and printers' own; confirm them against current platform specifications before a campaign ships.

letterhead.name: Letterhead · US Letter
letterhead.stock: 70–80 lb uncoated text, white or natural; laser and inkjet compatible.
letterhead.note: Minimal prints without bleed in the office; Accent and Bold need a press with bleed.

letterhead-second.name: Second sheet · US Letter
letterhead-second.stock: Same stock as the first sheet.

brochure.name: Tri-fold brochure · letter
brochure.stock: 100 lb gloss or silk text; 80 lb uncoated for Minimal.
brochure.note: Roll fold: the tuck-in panel is 1/16″ narrower than the other two.

booklet.name: Booklet · 6 × 9 trade
booklet.stock: Interior 60–70 lb natural uncoated text; cover 100 lb cover with matte laminate.
booklet.note: Saddle-stitched at 48 pages or fewer with a page count that is a multiple of 4; perfect bound above that.

worksheet.name: Worksheet · US Letter
worksheet.stock: 24 lb bond or 70 lb uncoated text so it takes pen and pencil.
worksheet.note: No bleed: a white margin on every template so it prints on any office printer.

calendar.name: Calendar · US Letter
calendar.stock: 100 lb uncoated cover, so the sheet pins flat and takes pen.
calendar.note: Two single-sheet templates share this format: the year at a glance and the month page.

notepad.name: Notepad · half letter
notepad.stock: 60–70 lb uncoated text, 50 sheets, padded at the head onto chipboard.
notepad.note: Top-glued: the padding compound takes about 1/8″ at the head, so nothing sits above the safe line.

notepad-desk.name: Desk pad · 4 × 6
notepad-desk.stock: Same text stock, 50 sheets, padded at the head.

pull-up.name: Retractable pull-up banner
pull-up.stock: 13 oz anti-curl vinyl or polyester fabric.
pull-up.note: The bottom 8″ disappears into the stand cassette; keep everything critical above it.

wide-banner.name: Hanging or table banner
wide-banner.stock: 13 oz matte vinyl with grommets, or dye-sublimated fabric.
wide-banner.note: Grommets sit 1″ in from each corner and every 24″; nothing within 1.5″ of the edge.

poster-11x17.name: Poster · tabloid
poster-11x17.stock: 100 lb gloss text; in-office or digital press.

poster-18x24.name: Poster · medium
poster-18x24.stock: 100 lb silk cover or 9 mil satin photo paper.

poster-24x36.name: Poster · large
poster-24x36.stock: 9 mil satin photo paper; foam-core mount for easels.

poster-27x40.name: Poster · one-sheet
poster-27x40.stock: 9 mil satin photo paper, or backlit film for light boxes.

gdn-320x50.name: Mobile banner
gdn-320x50.note: Too small for a disclaimer line; do not use it where one is required.

rda-1200x628.name: Responsive landscape
rda-1200x628.note: The platform crops and overlays its own copy on responsive ads; keep text off the image.

rda-1200x1200.name: Responsive square
rda-1200x1200.note: The platform crops and overlays its own copy on responsive ads; keep text off the image.

web-1920x600.name: Webinar page hero
web-1920x600.note: The outer 240 px crop away on narrow screens; keep copy in the centre 1440 px.

zoom-1920x1080.name: Virtual background
zoom-1920x1080.note: The speaker covers the central keep-clear region; the brand sits top left and the message upper right.

eventbrite-2160x1080.name: Eventbrite event image
eventbrite-2160x1080.note: Listings crop toward the centre; keep the headline in the middle 1600 px.

ig-1080x1350.name: Instagram portrait
ig-1080x1350.note: The profile grid crops portrait posts to 3:4; keep copy inside the centred 1012 × 1350.
